name: @cg/loans
//: The app's loan module since #5, when apps/loan-app folded into lib/loans. It is a workspace member for this manifest alone and has no scripts: the app serves it under /bank, scripts/loans.ts runs it on a port of its own, and the root tsconfig typechecks it.`governed: true` marks this as the business system under governance: the part a forker throws away and replaces with their own domain. It must declare no @cg/* dependency, which `app-test/loans/knows-nothing-about-governance.test.ts` enforces, and `packages/policy-schema`'s every-workspace sweep reads the same flag to exempt it. See #33.
